kicker: {n, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} · newest first

empty.title: No orders here
empty.text: Orders appear here once a sale is saved. Start one with New sale.

form.customerHelpAgent: Your approved customers. Add a new one from Customers.
form.customerHelp: Approved customers. The order stays with the customer's agent.
form.belowMinimum: Add {n} more cartons to reach the minimum of {min}.
form.noteHelp: Shown on the order, not on the proforma.
form.termsDays: {n, plural, =0 {Pay before delivery} one {# day} other {# days}}
form.advanceNeeded: From 834 cartons this price needs payment in advance or a volume commitment.
form.needCustomer: Choose a customer to send the payment request.
form.needCartons: Add {n} more cartons to send the payment request.
form.sent: Payment request sent to the customer.

pending.correction: A correction is waiting for an admin. Nothing changes until it is approved.
pending.special_price: The special price is waiting for an admin. Send the payment request once it is approved.
pending.new_customer: The customer is waiting for approval.

order.holdReleased: The stock hold was released on {date} because the payment did not arrive. The order stays open.
order.tierNote: {n} cartons fall in the {from}–{to} tier: {price} per unit.
order.noDocuments: Documents appear once the payment request is sent.

money.noteDraft: Nothing is owed until the payment request is sent.
money.noteOwed: {amount} still to pay. The order ships only when it is paid in full.

delete.title: Delete draft
delete.consequence: The draft is removed. Nothing was sent to the customer.

special_price.title: Ask for a special price
special_price.priceHelp: Below the list price. The difference comes out of your commission.
special_price.reasonHelp: Why this customer needs it. The admin sees this.

confirm_payment.title: Confirm payment
confirm_payment.partHelp: A smaller amount records a part payment; the order ships once it is paid in full.
confirm_payment.consequence: Once paid in full the order becomes Paid · ready to send, or waits for stock.

send_to_warehouse.title: Send to warehouse
send_to_warehouse.consequence: The warehouse gets the order without prices. Quantities are fixed from now on.

issue_invoice.title: Issue commercial invoice
issue_invoice.partNote: The cartons that came back are credited on a credit note issued with the invoice.
issue_invoice.consequence: The invoice is e-mailed to the customer, the agent, the admins and the accountant. It never changes.

part_outcome.title: Decide on the part delivery
part_outcome.summary: {n, plural, one {# carton came back} other {# cartons came back}} to the warehouse.
part_outcome.consequence_credit_note: The invoice covers the order and a credit note covers the cartons that came back.
part_outcome.consequence_redeliver: The warehouse delivers the missing cartons again before the invoice.
part_outcome.done_credit_note: The returned cartons will be credited with the invoice.

correction.title: Ask for a correction
correction.reasonHelp: What changed and why. The admin sees this.
correction.consequence: After approval the customer gets a corrected proforma. The current one stays as it is.

cancel.title: Cancel order
cancel.paidWarning: {amount} was already paid. Arrange the refund separately.
cancel.consequence: The reserved stock is released and the commission is removed.

credit_note.title: Issue credit note
credit_note.consequence: The credit note references the invoice and is e-mailed to the customer and the agent. Returned cartons go back to stock.
